=== one instruction | -g
	.text
	nop
=== lines apart | -g

	.text
	nop
	nop

	# a comment
	nop
=== no code | -g
	.data
	.byte 1
=== DWARF 2 | --gdwarf-2
	.text
	nop
	nop
=== DWARF 3 | --gdwarf-3
	.text
	nop
	nop
=== DWARF 4 | --gdwarf-4
	.text
	nop
	nop
=== DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.text
	nop
	nop
=== labels | -g
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	nop
g:
	nop
.Lh:
	nop
=== sections | -g
	.text
	nop
	.data
	.byte 1
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	nop
	nop
	.text
	nop
=== sections, DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.text
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
g:
	nop
	.text
	nop
=== code in data | -g
	.data
	nop
	.text
	nop
=== starting in data | -g
	.data
	.byte 1
	.text
	nop
	nop
=== a macro | -g
	.macro twice
	nop
	nop
	.endm
	.text
	nop
	twice
	nop
	twice
=== a repeat | -g
	.text
	.rept 3
	nop

	nop
	.endr
	nop
=== an irp | -g
	.text
	.irp x, 1, 2
	nop
	nop
	.endr
	nop
=== a numbered file turns it off | -g
	.text
	nop
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.loc 1 5
	nop
=== frames too | -g
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== line table only
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.data
	.byte 1
=== functions | -g
	.text
	.globl f
	.type f, %function
f:
	nop
	nop
	.size f, .-f
	.type g, %function
g:
	nop
	.size g, .-g
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	.type h, %function
h:
	nop
	.size h, .-h
=== functions, DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.text
	.type f, %function
f:
	nop
	.size f, .-f
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	.globl h
	.type h, %function
h:
	nop
	.size h, .-h
